title: The Lost House Key
story: Marta left her flat at eight and walked to the small market on her street. She locked the front door and dropped the house key into her coat pocket. The morning was cool, and the bread stall already had a short queue. Marta bought a loaf and a bag of apples. She paid, said thank you, and turned toward home. At the corner she put her hand into the pocket. The key was not there. She stopped and checked the other pocket, then her bag, and then the ground by her feet. She felt hot and worried. Her neighbour Pedro was coming out of the shop. He saw her face and asked what was wrong. Marta said she had lost the house key. Pedro walked back to the bread stall with her. The seller looked under the counter and held up one key. It had been on the ground beside the apples. Later Marta tried it in her own door, and the lock turned. She thanked Pedro and the seller. That evening she fixed a small hook on the wall by the door. She hung the key there before she went to bed. The next morning the key was still on the hook, and Marta left home calm and on time.

so the apples would stay fresh
